description: Authored normalized echo envelope with a separate receive-retention mask. No physical receiver or acoustic propagation simulation.
formula: G(x,w)=exp(-0.5*(x/w)^2). First=0.46*(0.85+0.15*cos(0.15*p))*G(b-(42+1.6*p),3.5). Second=0.34*(0.85+0.15*sin(0.22*p))*G(b-(189-1.25*p),5). Transient=0.28*G(p-15,1.7)*G(b-222,3). Background=0.018+0.007*sin(1.3*b+0.33*p)+0.005*cos(0.18*b-0.4*p). Available amplitude=float32(clamp(sum,0,1)). p is ping index; b is delay bin. Component names are authored terms, not recovered objects.
timing: Ping p originates at timeOrigin+p seconds. Delay b is b*0.001 seconds after transmission, not the ping interval. Receive offset is p+b*0.001 seconds. UTC is authored, with no physical clock traceability.
distance: Conditional one-way path length=1500*two-way delay/2 metres. Constant sound speed is assumed, not measured. No direction, depth or straight-line position is established. Bin spacing is not physical range resolution.
availability: Mask0 for pings28..30, and for pings44..49 with bins120..151; otherwise1. Mask0 means amplitude not retained. Its float32 slot is a zero placeholder, not a measured value. Gaps are authored omissions without an inferred physical cause.
limits: No physical calibration or sound-pressure units
No waveform, Doppler or carrier-frequency model
No beam geometry, localization or bathymetry
No detector, tracking or object identities
No pulse bandwidth, propagation, multipath or measured sound-speed profile
